upload_boundary: An upload acknowledgement is not a verified remote read-back or restore test.
not_recorded: No restore test result is recorded here. Inspect a copy before restoring to a new directory.
needs_attention: Review the checks below before changing system settings. An optional feature being off is different from a failed check.
mail_steps: 1. Save the selected provider and sender. 2. Send a test. 3. Confirm it arrived in your inbox. Saving settings is not proof of delivery.
availability_impact: Review visitor access before saving. Public shows content; construction shows your message; password mode requires an unlock. Admin access stays separate.
workspace_boundary: This choice changes navigation visibility only. It does not grant or revoke permissions. Use Roles to control access.
inbox_next: No messages yet. Open a published contact page to check its form, or create one in Pages.
private_boundary: Private reports are separate from ordinary contact messages. Only authorized reviewers can open their details.
updates_steps: 1. Create and verify a local backup. 2. Request deployment. 3. Check the running version and health. An accepted request is not a completed update.
ext_review: Before installing, review the package source, manifest and requested capabilities. Installation does not establish trust in its publisher.
outbound: Outbound: GoRun sends selected events to your service. Signed inbound agent commands are configured on the relevant canvas card.
storage_boundary: A selected destination is configuration, not proof that a backup can be restored. Review connection test results below and upload receipts on Backups.
errors_help: Start with repeated or current failures. A recorded or retried event has not necessarily been resolved.
reports_checklist: Before enabling: appoint authorized reviewers, publish a privacy notice, and test the incident and follow-up routes. This checklist does not verify those steps for you.
migration_steps: Connect → scan → map → preview → import → validate. Preview the mapping before importing; keep a separate backup for rollback.
metricool_help: Use the numeric user ID and brand/blog ID from your Metricool account. Save the connection, verify it, then create a draft; saving is not verification.
seo_help: Review concrete missing fields first, then editorial suggestions. A suggestion requires a human decision and is not proof of a search-ranking problem.
users_boundary: Filter by role to distinguish the team from customer accounts. A role controls access; account status controls whether sign-in is enabled.
general_source: Site name and logo are shared with Identity. Changes here update the same saved settings.
security_limits: Counts cover the displayed sample: up to50 recent failures and512 active blocks, not all-time attempts.
page_policy_help: Each row shows the saved page policy. Whole-site and platform restrictions can still override it; translations have independent policies.
nav_preview_help: Preview follows the choices and order in this form. Pinned items stay visible. Saving changes your navigation, not your permissions.
task_boundary: These are saved role permissions. Individual content scope, recent-auth checks and other feature requirements still apply.
seo_filter_note: Filters affect the displayed rows; summary totals still describe the complete scan. Field checks identify missing or invalid saved values; editorial suggestions require review.
workspace_simple: Content-focused: articles, pages and site editing. Agent/commerce groups, canvases and connection management are hidden. Permissions are still enforced independently.
workspace_full: Advanced: installed content, agent and commerce modules can appear when the current user has permission. This does not activate providers, billing or integrations.
users_audience_note: Customers have the saved customer role. Team / other roles includes every other role; this grouping does not grant staff access.
role_clone_help: Copies the saved permissions into a new role. The administrator wildcard is excluded; saving remains subject to your grant permissions and recent authentication.
role_no_changes: No permission changes. Name changes can still be saved.
role_diff_boundary: This is a preview of the current form against the saved role. The server checks current permissions and recent authentication again when saving.
saved_role_boundary: These are the account’s currently saved role grants, not unsaved role selections. Content scope, ownership, account status, recent authentication and integration grants can impose additional limits.
role_unavailable: Role permissions are unavailable. No access result is inferred.
